title: *Intended Nationally Determined Contribution* (UNFCCC5)
organization: Government of the Islamic Republic of Afghanistan / NEPA; UNFCCC repository
methodology: National consultation and policy synthesis; climate projections and adaptation priorities
limitations: Pre-2021 institutional context; adaptation costs and priorities are plans, not demonstrated implementation.

title: *Second National Communication under the UNFCCC* (UNFCCC1)
methodology: GSWP3 reanalysis; CORDEX regional models; seven-model ensembles; vulnerability/capacity assessment
limitations: Older model generation; precipitation uncertainty high; institutional information predates August 2021.

title: *Climate, Peace and Security Fact Sheet: Afghanistan* (NUPI3)
temporal_coverage: Mainly 2021-2026; climate series to 2024/projections to mid-century
methodology: Literature/secondary-data synthesis and climate-security pathway framework
limitations: Not a causal-identification study; several statistics derive from secondary sources; local examples cannot support national causal claims.

title: *Afghanistan: IPC Acute Food Insecurity Analysis, September 2025-September 2026* (IPCinfo7)
methodology: IPC consensus classification drawing on food security, livelihood, market, climate and humanitarian data
limitations: Classification/projection, not causal evaluation; climate is one of several drivers.

title: *Afghanistan Socioeconomic Review, 2024-2025* (UNDP2)
methodology: WoAA July-Aug 2025 plus administrative/UN sources; bespoke Subsistence Insecurity Index
limitations: Cross-sectional survey evidence; some indices are UNDP constructs; some subgroup analysis restricted to common provinces.

title: *From Return to Rebuild for Afghan Returnees and Host Communities* (UNDP8)
organization: UNDP Regional Bureau for Asia and the Pacific
methodology: Primarily WoAA 2025: 48,711 households, including 1,505 returnee households
limitations: Policy synthesis and programme recommendations; claims about proposed area-based approaches are theory/intended mechanisms, not evaluated effects.

title: *Afghanistan Development Update* (The World Bank9)
methodology: Macroeconomic estimation, administrative sources, World Bank datasets and 2025 Enterprise Survey
limitations: Macro estimates and projections; cannot isolate climatic effects from returns, borders, policy, aid and other drivers.

title: *World Bank & Afghanistan Resilience Trust Fund Support for the People of Afghanistan* (World Bank10)
methodology: Administrative programme description, financing and monitoring arrangements
limitations: Describes intended/current delivery and monitoring architecture, not independent evidence of outcomes or adaptation effectiveness.

title: *Adapting Afghan Communities to Climate-Induced Disaster Risks - Terminal Evaluation* (Evaluation Resource Center6)
geographic_coverage: Project communities, mainly Nangarhar and Jawzjan plus institutional components
methodology: Document review and stakeholder consultation by an external evaluator
limitations: Activities suspended Aug 2021 and never resumed; nearly two-year gap; mainly remote evaluation; incomplete information for some cost-effectiveness questions.

title: *Final Evaluation of UNDP GEF-LDCF2 Project Afghanistan: Strengthening the resilience of rural livelihood options...* (Evaluation Resource Center11)
methodology: Evaluation team review, fieldwork, stakeholder interviews and project monitoring evidence
limitations: Security constrained field access; Uruzgan implementation/evaluation evidence was particularly constrained; weak indicators and M&E limit outcome attribution.

title: *Crisis Compounded: Afghanistan’s Returnees Face an Escalating Water Emergency* (Mercy Corps4)
methodology: Survey of 292 returnee households plus secondary research
limitations: Local sample; many causal attributions are respondent perceptions or report synthesis; groundwater stress has climatic and non-climatic drivers.

title: *No place to stay, no place to go: perspectives from climate-affected areas of Balkh province* (ACAPS12)
geographic_coverage: Dehdadi, Nahr Shahi, Sholgareh districts, Balkh
methodology: Secondary review + experts + purposive qualitative study of 84 participants, interviews/FGDs/households, thematic analysis
limitations: Purposive local study; translation and access limitations; unsuitable for estimating prevalence or national effects.

title: *After return: Rebuilding livelihoods for Afghan women* (ecoi.net13)
methodology: Telephone survey of 582 returnee women, 80 qualitative participants, participatory market work
limitations: Cross-sectional/self-reported; phone frame may exclude women without phones or in highly restrictive households; small earnings subsample; no causal inference.

title: *Nationally Determined Contributions Registry - Afghanistan entry* (UNFCCC14)
limitations: Registry metadata, not substantive adaptation evidence.
